operations.name: Cottage Food Vending
operations.description: Vending for cottage food products made by My Kronee Cafe.

about: SNACKS-4-U started as QUALITY VENDING through the acquisition of an existing FL company with 6 manual u-turn machines in 2002. After the founder’s divorce of his nine year marriage, the founder renamed to SNACKS-4-U in Ulster County, NY. In 2011, the founder converted the sole proprietorship to a corporation, acquired a commercial office, bought about 30 vendstar triple head machines, hired a placement director to locate the machines and a local business major student to managed the business during the week, and won two government contracts with the opening of a restaurant called Big Apple News & Grub. Losses due to theft resulted in the relocation to FL in 2016 and the establishment of the DBA under the single parent corporation known as PRESSPAGE ENTERTAINMENT INC. The new FL DBA would concentrate on cottage food vending and small footprint cashless systems.
